newsitem.title: USA: TRW says has China seat belt venture.
newsitem.headline: TRW says has China seat belt venture.

text.p: TRW Inc said it formed a joint venture with Shanghai Clutch Factory, a unit of Shanghai Automotive Industrial Corp, to make and sell auto seat belts in China. Terms were not disclosed.
The joint venture company will be called Shanghai TRW Automotive Safety Systems, TRW said in a statement Thursday.

TRW and Shanghai Clutch have worked together since 1993 when the China company licensed TRW's seat belt retractor technology, TRW said. Under the existing agreement, Shanghai Clutch produces more than 500,000 seat belts a year.
The joint venture company expects to more than triple production by the year 2000, TRW said.

The Cleveland-based automotive and space/defense firm said it has formed or expects to form alliances in China for auto electronics, switches, engine valves, steering gears and occupant restraint systems.
Separately, as reported, TRW said the Odyssey satellite system, which it is building in a joint venture with Canada's Teleglobe Inc, has an agreement to provide cellular telephone service in China.
TRW had 1995 sales of $10 billion. Its stock closed off Friday 1/8 at 52-1/2.
